## Summary

Adds a platform-neutral ARWG survey.

The survey contains 16 questions and specifies the intended response behavior, including required fields, matrices, screen-out paths, inline write-ins, and answer ordering.

The survey has five question sections:

- Eligibility (Q1)
- About the system (Q2–Q5)
- Benefits and challenges (Q6–Q8)
- Accuracy and reliability (Q9–Q13)
- Future priorities (Q14–Q16)

It includes welcome messaging, a dedicated early-exit thank-you page for Q1’s three screen-out choices, and a post-submission thank-you message. Q2 includes a “Something else” option with a required text field. Q5 and Q16 are optional; all other questions are required. Q6 and Q10 each use five response choices, including “Not sure.”

## Google Forms prototype

You can try the current Google Forms prototype here:

[Open the Google Forms prototype](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfrKDDrqocQRByBLLetN-F4rYmZEmCi6iIgSKzqsT-KerKBAg/viewform)

This is a working prototype for review. Please don’t share it with respondents yet.

## Review requested

Please review whether:

- the survey flow is clear to respondents;
- every response path is complete and unambiguous;
- the response mechanics support useful analysis; and
- any questions should be added, removed, or simplified to improve clarity and keep the survey easy to complete.
